components.css: .ds-news-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:77px minmax(0,1fr);padding:24px 0 27px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e1e7e5);color:var(--ink,#1d2929);font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif}.ds-news-time{position:relative;padding:6px 0 0 20px;color:#586a60;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}.ds-news-time i{position:absolute;top:10px;left:0;width:7px;height:7px;border:2px solid #d4785b;border-radius:50%;background:#fff}.ds-news-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px}.ds-news-meta span{color:#586a60;font-size:11px}.ds-news-meta em{margin-left:auto;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #f0d5ca;border-radius:3px;background:#fbebe5;color:#ac513c;font-size:10px;font-style:normal}.ds-news-body p{max-width:73ch;margin:15px 0 16px;color:#2b3b36;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.8}.ds-news-body a{color:#4f7567;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-news-body a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}.ds-news-body a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e38b6b;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: The interface reads like a working newsroom desk: a fixed dark account rail beside a light, information-dense reporting surface. Its personality comes from editorial hierarchy, a timestamped feed, restrained green surfaces, and small coral signals for fresh or exceptional items. Counts and source details stay easy to scan. A full-width, user-triggered Chinese digest leads the working area, followed by the run overview and chronological original-post feed. A narrow right rail holds run details and settings; compact tags distinguish new items and summary state.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational density with a clear reading order.
Dark green navigation against a pale reporting canvas.
Thin dividers and tonal surfaces, with very little shadow.
Coral used sparingly for new-item and error cues.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep coral in small marks and state cues so new activity remains noticeable among neutral rows.

rules.name: The Numeric Readout Rule
rules.body: Use DM Sans for prominent counts and feed times; keep prose in the shared bilingual stack.

rules.name: The Divider Rule
rules.body: Use border and background contrast to structure dense information before adding elevation.

dos: Do keep account navigation, current-run metrics, and post history visually distinct through position and dividers.
Do reserve warm accent color for the timeline, fresh items, and exceptional status.
Do keep source links and original text accessible from every feed entry.
donts: Don't turn each feed entry into a floating card; the implemented feed is a continuous chronological list.
Don't use large shadows or rounded promotional blocks in the working area.
Don't rely on color alone for new or failed states; retain the explicit labels and counts.
